Steam adventure performance / writing choice source reconstruction
Image identity: PE:6a70a6d9:02711000
Image base: 0x140000000
This is source extraction and semantic reconstruction, not an execution result.
Names below are descriptive aliases, not recovered native symbol names.
Choice-ID names follow performance_menu_choice_type in
data/upstream/df-structures/df.d_interface.xml; the native object fields and
event-filter calls below establish the site/HF/entity/subregion distinction.

Source ranges and their direct text-producing callees
----------------------------------------------------
menu rebuild       0x140854ec0..0x140858260
renderer           0x140870260..0x140872cec
option insertion   0x140858260 (caption sorting / insertion; no English literal)
sphere caption     0x140756690..0x140757380
poetic form        0x140e76400..0x140e7cec8
musical form       0x140dd5ce0..0x140ddd464
dance form         0x1404ea820..0x1404eeb08
written content    0x140cc5d50..0x140cc6a0e
story/object prose 0x140b8eeb0..0x140b92634
generated name     0x140a946e0
personal name      0x140a94030

Each corresponding steam-helper-ADDRESS.asm preserves actual native instructions,
call sites and string addresses. steam-literals.tsv retains every referenced
ASCII string including repeated references and suffix slices produced by SIMD
string construction. steam-unique-text.tsv groups the unique native literals by
the enclosing text producer. Suffix slices are not separate UI sentences.
steam-jump-tables.tsv preserves all 21 state destinations, 33 value destinations,
26 menu genre destinations, 130 sphere destinations, empty-state destinations,
all option IDs 8..39 renderer destinations and 26 work-description destinations.
steam-enumerated-text.tsv pairs finite indices with their actual branch literals.
steam-book-articles.tsv preserves the native byte remap for a/an per work genre.

Menu rebuild state switch (table 0x140858120, valid state 0..20)
--------------------------------------------------------------
State 0, branch 0x140854f9e: main action choices.
  ID 0 Tell a story; ID 20 Give a sermon; ID 1 Recite a poem;
  ID 2 Perform music; ID 3 Dance; ID 34 Prepare choreography;
  ID 32 Compose music; ID 30 Compose a poem; ID 36 Write something down.
  Availability conditions decide which actions are inserted; the literals do
  not change with those conditions.
State 1, 0x1408555b3: story subject type.
  ID 5 Tell a story about a person or creature; ID 4 Tell a story about a site;
  ID 6 Tell a story about a civilization or organization;
  ID 7 Tell a story about a region.
State 2, 0x14085570b: known site name objects, ID 8 (STORY_SITE).
  collectKnownSites source is world+0xf01de0; name helper 0x140a946e0.
State 3, 0x140855dcd: person/creature historical figures, ID 9.
  Figure/identity name alternatives invoke 0x140a946e0; unavailable native
  names produce the explicit Unknown literal, not a different action caption.
State 4, 0x14085689c: civilization/organization entities, ID 10 (STORY_ENTITY).
  Entity name is at object+0x20 and ID at +0x3c; helper 0x140a946e0.
State 5, 0x14085698b: region objects, ID 11 (STORY_SUBREGION).
  Source is world+0xf01cb0, region name at object+0x78; same name helper.
State 6, 0x140856a77: subject-related historical events, ID 12.
  Subject kind 8/9/10/11 (site/HF/entity/subregion) selects event filters
  through virtual slots +0x90/+0x88/+0xc0/+0xa8, respectively. Actual calls:
  ID8 -> 0x140856dea; ID9 -> 0x140856cea;
  ID10 -> 0x140856bea; ID11 -> 0x140856aea.
  Accepted event captions use virtual slot +0xd8.
State 7, 0x140856ebf: poetic forms (ID 13) and poems (ID 14).
  Generated form name is at form+8; work title is at work+8.
State 8, 0x140857167: musical forms (ID 15) and compositions (ID 16).
  Same form-name / title distinction.
State 9, 0x140857417: musical performer role (ID 17).
  Instrument-bearing role: Play + actual item caption (virtual +0x188 or
  native item helper 0x140c65450), or Simulate + instrument raw title (+0x68).
  Role without instrument: flag 1 gives Sing; otherwise flag 4 gives Chant;
  otherwise Speak. Instrument captions are generated fields, not fixed names.
State 10, 0x140857868: dance forms (ID 18) and choreography (ID 19).
State 11, 0x14085545b: sermon type.
  ID 21 Give a sermon concerning a deity or object of worship
  ID 22 Give a sermon concerning a cosmic principle
  ID 23 Give a sermon promoting a value
  ID 24 Give a sermon inveighing against a value
State 12, 0x1408557fb: deity/worship historical figures, ID 25.
  Names come from figure+0x38 through helper 0x140a946e0. Missing native name
  uses Unknown. These are world-generated deity/object names, not a closed list.
State 13, 0x140855b46: cosmic spheres, ID 26.
  Loop compares index against 0x82 at 0x140855bb3: indices 0..129 inclusive.
  Each caption invokes 0x140756690 at 0x140855b7c; its jump table is
  0x140757174. There are 130 sphere captions. Out-of-range helper input gives
  no sphere; that fallback is also extracted. This is not a 91-entry list.
State 14, 0x140855bc1: belief values, ID 27 (promote).
State 15, 0x140855bc1: same 33 belief values, ID 28 (oppose).
  Actual value switch table is 0x140858174; Law through Knowledge are preserved
  verbatim and indexed in steam-enumerated-text.tsv.
State 16, 0x140857b17: available poetic forms to compose, ID 31.
  Form pointer vector at menu+0xd8, generated name at form+8.
State 17, 0x140857bcf: available musical forms to compose, ID 33.
  Form pointer vector at menu+0xf0, generated name at form+8.
State 18, 0x140857c7f: available dance forms to choreograph, ID 35.
  Form pointer vector at menu+0x108, generated name at form+8.
State 19, 0x140857d2f: writing medium / writable item, ID 37.
  Object vector at menu+0x130..0x138; item caption virtual slot +0x5e8.
  This state is not the memorized-work vector, despite the shared renderer title.
State 20, 0x140857e19: prose genre ID 38 and memorized work ID 39.
  Genre integer vector at menu+0x148, 26 switch literals at 0x1408581f8.
  Memorized-work pointer vector at menu+0x160; caption is work title (+8).
  ID 29 has no creation branch in this menu rebuild.

Renderer headers and non-choice text
------------------------------------
state 16: Choose a poetic form for the composition.
state 17: Choose a musical form for the composition.
state 18: Choose a dance form for the choreography.
states 19 AND 20: Select memorized content or a form of prose.
all other states: What would you like to do?
Done is constructed as immediate DWORD 0x656e6f44 rather than a literal pointer.
Empty states 2..6: You don't know anything specific about this, unfortunately.
Empty states 7,8,10: You must compose a piece first (or learn an improvisational form).
Empty states 12..15: You don't believe anything relevant, unfortunately.
  followed by: Assume an appropriate identity first if you'd like to pretend.
The empty-state switch has no message for states 9 and 11.
Search/control literals: ... and _; clipped description: (etc.).
Rich text markers include [C:6:0:1] and [B]. These delimit color and paragraph
construction; they are not visible English words.

Selected option description switch (table 0x140872be0 for ID minus 8)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
ID 8/9/10/11: resolve selected site/person/organization/region, create subject
  reference, then invoke story/object prose helper 0x140b8eeb0. The branch targets
  are respectively 0x140871085/0x1408711dc/0x140871335/0x14087148e.
ID 12: selected event description via its native virtual description method;
  branch 0x1408715e7. It is not a fixed title-only description.
ID 25: deity/worship subject detail, branch 0x140870f66, prose helper call
  0x140871052 -> 0x140b8eeb0, same semantic subject-description path as stories.
ID 13: poetic form alone, branch 0x140871698; call 0x140871779 -> 0x140e76400.
ID 15: musical form alone, branch 0x1408719af; call 0x140871aac -> 0x140dd5ce0.
ID 18: dance form alone, branch 0x140871dc5; call 0x140871e92 -> 0x1404ea820.
ID 31/33/35: newly chosen form alone, branches 0x14087219b/0x14087225c/
  0x1408722e3; calls 0x1408721ef/0x1408722b0/0x140872337 to the same helpers.
ID 14/16/19: individual poem/composition/choreography construction below.
ID 39: memorized written work construction below.
Other IDs in 8..39 jump to 0x140872949 without a prose-building branch here.

Individual performed works (ID 14 / ID 16 / ID 19)
-------------------------------------------------
work_id = selected_option.payload (+0x68)
work = lookup corresponding global work collection by ID
form_id = work+0x6c; form = lookup corresponding form collection
prefix = [C:6:0:1] + work.title(+8) + " is an example of "
if form exists:
  prefix += generated_name(form+8, helper 0x140a946e0) + ".  "
  prefix += written_content(work, helper 0x140cc5d50, mode 0)
  prefix += "[B]"
  prefix += complete_form_description(form)
else:
  prefix += "poetry" / "musical composition" / "choreography" + ".  "
  prefix += written_content(work, helper 0x140cc5d50, mode 0)
No authored-by clause is generated in these three performed-work branches.
Poem content call 0x140871919 then [B] at 0x14087191e then helper at 0x14087193b.
Music content call 0x140871c5d then [B] then helper at 0x140871c7f.
Dance content call 0x14087211e then [B] then helper at 0x14087214f.
The form helper append is the entire form document; translating only its first
identity sentence loses native rule/section/role descriptions.

Memorized work (ID 39; branch 0x1408723a4)
----------------------------------------
work = menu[+0x160][selected_option.payload(+0x68)]
genre = work+0x68 (0..25); genre literal table at 0x140872c84
if title length at work+0x18 is nonzero:
  prefix = [C:6:0:1] + title(+8) + " is " + article(genre) + " " + genre
else:
  prefix = [C:6:0:1] + "This is an untitled" + " " + genre
author_id = work+0xa0
if author_id != -1 and historical figure lookup finds author:
  prefix += ", authored by "
  author_name_object = helper 0x140c0f660(author)
  if name object exists and its named byte (+0x72) is set:
    prefix += personal_name(author_name_object, helper 0x140a94030)
  # If figure exists but name is unavailable, authored-by stays with empty name.
prefix += ".  "
if genre == 7 (poem) / 12 (musical composition) / 13 (choreography)
  and form(work+0x6c) is found:
  prefix += "It is an example of " + generated_name(form+8) + ".  "
  prefix += written_content(work, mode 0) + "[B]" + complete_form_description(form)
else:
  prefix += written_content(work, mode 0)
Thus titled-a, titled-an and untitled each have named-author, omitted-author,
and empty-author constructions. Omitted/empty author does not remove content.

Written content helper 0x140cc5d50
---------------------------------
Reference pointers: work+0x30..0x38; parallel reference-type array: work+0x48.
Type 0 supplies subjects; type 5 supplies chapter references. Reference prose is
generated through its virtual slot +0x90. It is not an arbitrary UI string slot.
Subject construction:
  genre 20 and one subject -> It asks the question, "What if {reference} had unfolded differently?"
  genre 16 -> It concerns the lineage of {reference}.
  ordinary subjects -> It concerns {reference list}.
  no subjects -> The work has no particular subject.
Additional constructions:
  The writing conveys a moral lesson regarding {reference list}.
  The overall text emphasizes {reference list}.
  For lyrics, the composer has selected {reference list}.
  For musical accompaniment, the choreographer has selected {reference list}.
  The writing {style} [and it / yet it {style}].
Quality branches have six literal alternatives each for information, poetry,
composition, choreography and prose. All thirty are in the written_content
category of steam-unique-text.tsv, including information quality such as
"Overall, the information is compiled masterfully" and the complete negative
alternatives. Quality is appended to the same document, not a separate menu.
Chapter construction:
  The work has a single chapter. / The work has {count} chapters.
  It covers {reference}. / The {ordinal} chapter covers {reference}.
The helper includes content, style, quality and every chapter; no prefix-only
translation can represent its output.

Shared translation route used by this source family
--------------------------------------------------
Written-work introductions and 0x140cc5d50 content use complete h-namespace
legends templates with typed nested references, plus work-sentence and
work-reference productions in announcement-combat-grammar.tsv.
Poetic form source uses the complete poetic identity/rule/section grammar;
musical and dance source use their existing complete semantic paragraph grammars.
Story/object source uses the full legends description grammar and generated-name
translation. The native [B] boundary separates work prose from form prose.
The adventure description card now retains that boundary and the introduction,
resolves contiguous poetic paragraphs together, and replaces the card only when
every paragraph has a complete translation. No head-only stripping is required.
